sources.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one finished transparent 2D physics-game sprite, a wide-foot friendly toilet, no surrounding UI.
Primary request: create ONE glossy white ceramic toilet character with soft icy blue edge shading and two cheerful dark blue eyes on its left water tank. This is a funny high-quality collectible object for a stacking game, a charming polished 3D mobile-game render, not a photograph.
SHAPE is critical: strictly near-orthographic LEFT SIDE elevation, looking straight horizontally at the side, no isometric angle. Overall silhouette width:height about 125:115 (slightly wider than tall). High upright water tank at LEFT, low CLOSED seat lid extending to RIGHT, broad integrated white-ceramic pedestal underneath. The tank's outer top outline has a genuinely straight horizontal flat about 43/125 of overall width. The seat lid's outer top outline has another straight horizontal flat about 60/125 of overall width, 37/115 lower than the tank top. The high and low flats MUST be outer collision silhouette, not merely drawn internal perspective lines. Small rounded corners only. The left tank back is nearly vertical. The tank top plateau sits over the left part of the broad foot. The single integral ceramic pedestal flares broadly toward the LEFT below the tank and also toward the right, ending in an actually straight horizontal flat bottom 104/125 of total width; foot left edge is nearly aligned with the tank left edge. Avoid a small narrow central foot. Keep a shallow graceful waist/recess below the bowl so it still looks like a toilet, and retain the distinct upper step between tank and seat. The supporting ceramic foot must visibly be part of the toilet, never a separate platform, stand, board or prop.
Materials and style: lustrous glazed ceramic, clean soft blue bevels, broad painted highlights, soft contact shading in concavities, subtle silver flush handle on the tank side, playful friendly expression. Full production-quality surface and complete closed outer silhouette, substantial volume yet side view suitable for exact polygon collision. Clean polished detail, no grain.
Composition: isolated single subject centered, full body completely visible with generous transparent margins. Genuine alpha transparency. No ground, no environment, no cast floor shadow, no outline guides, no measuring arrows, no text, logos, labels or watermarks. Do not add feet, arms or accessory props. No open lid, no hollow hole in the silhouette, no perspective sloping support surfaces.
